culture.text: Founded in Delft in 2012, it handles payments, escrow, onboarding and payouts for hundreds of platforms across Europe.
Headquartered in Delft with offices in Valencia, Berlin and London; LinkedIn lists 238 employees.
Customer support and engineering are the biggest functions; staff often studied at The Hague University of Applied Sciences, Rotterdam UAS or Leiden.
